subject.title: refactor(providers): derive simple provider registrations from manifests

question: Should the shared single-provider Plugin SDK formally make manifest-derived registration the canonical contract for these 19 bundled providers?
rationale: This is more than a local cleanup: it changes the common plugin-entry API and shifts the source of truth for provider setup and catalog defaults, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Confirm the manifest-first SDK direction
options.body: Approve the shared contract after reviewing the current-main merge result and confirming that provider-specific overrides retain existing user-facing behavior.

options.title: Keep explicit registrations for now
options.body: Retain provider-local registration declarations if maintainers do not want manifests to become the canonical SDK input for bundled providers.

recommendation.title: Confirm the manifest-first SDK direction
recommendation.body: Approve the shared contract after reviewing the current-main merge result and confirming that provider-specific overrides retain existing user-facing behavior.
